integration.name: 360dialog
integration.tagline: Cloud API through a business provider
integration.summary: A Meta Business Solution Provider. The request and response shapes are the Cloud API’s, but the account and its paperwork go through 360dialog rather than through Meta directly.

credentials.label: API Key
credentials.note: A single key from the 360dialog client area. There is no second identifier — the key itself determines which number sends.

strengths: One key to connect, with no second identifier to keep in step
The same message shapes as the Cloud API, so behaviour is familiar
Account and billing handled by 360dialog rather than directly with Meta
considerations: This connection has no sender field: the key identifies the number, so which number messages leave from is decided in the 360dialog account rather than here.
